warning: 1 independent blocks is NOT ENOUGH to say anything. A block-bootstrap SE on this few blocks is itself unreliable, and the point estimates will move substantially. Roughly 100 blocks — about a year of daily observations at h=1 — is the minimum before this table carries information. Until then it is a plumbing check, not evidence.
backfill_caveat: Backfilled predictions were scored after the fact; this table is a plumbing check on the pipeline, not out-of-sample evidence.
